title: Parque de Niños (Children Playground Reference Scene)
prompt: The scene is a vibrant and inviting children's playground, rendered in a realistic style, capturing the joyful atmosphere of a sunny day in a lush green park. A large, multi-colored play structure dominates the center of the playground, featuring several slides of varying heights and colors, including bright red, yellow, and blue. Adjacent to the main structure, a set of swings with both traditional belt seats and toddler bucket seats hangs from a sturdy metal frame. A spacious sandbox, filled with fine, light-colored sand, is situated near the swings, complete with various colorful plastic toys scattered within.
